name: High Snooze | 200mg Chocolate Coin | Milk Chocolate (4:1 THC:CBN)
description: Smooth, classic, and made for winding down. The HIGH SNOOZE Milk Chocolate Coin delivers rich, creamy chocolate infused with 200mg THC and 50mg CBN for a deeply relaxing nighttime experience. Designed to help you ease into rest, this fast-acting formula pairs indulgent flavor with a calming effect that’s perfect for evening use.
